headline: Week 16: Nut Olave Drops 227 and Mills Drops Trou
subhead: Semifinal-adjacent carnage as Nut Olave Your Face puts up the highest score of the playoffs and Stroud Boys submits the lowest score of the year.
matchOfTheWeek: Egbukkake squeaking past QAmon by 2.68 is the kind of heart attack that ends marriages. Chase Brown bailed Szara out with 32.90, while Kyle's Tyjae Spears sat on the bench growing 21.5 points of mold next to Tiny-Handed Vampire's regular-season ass. A 2.68-point loss with your RB2 in street clothes — that's a wound that doesn't close.
powerRankingsShakeup: Nut Olave Your Face just announced themselves as the title favorite by hanging 227 like it was a Madden glitch, while McBridesStrangeWhiteHock and Stroud Boys are basically applying for offseason citizenship.
mainRecap:
Nickcelli didn't win a fantasy game this week, he committed a war crime. 227.80 to 97.20 — a 130-point dump truck on McBridesStrangeWhiteHock that included 36.80 from Better than Bo, 30.20 from Madison Beer's side piece, and 29.80 from Mustard. 95.3% lineup efficiency. LargestOfRocks should file a police report; that wasn't a matchup, that was an open-casket viewing.

Meanwhile in the saddest game on the slate, Stroud Boys posted 73.98. SEVENTY-THREE. In Week 16. Of the playoffs. Bjewett got curb-stomped by Little Peckers — yes, the 126-point Little Peckers — by 52. The Prodigal Son has prodigaled himself right into a top-3 pick. Money Mill$ couldn't even bribe his way to relevance.

OnlyFants put up 215 because Cubby apparently rostered three of the top seven QBs in football this week (Purdy, Trevor Lawrence, and Jeanty doing his best Saquon impression). Rub My Chubb scored 151 and still lost by 64. BigD did nothing wrong and got dunked on anyway — that's playoff fantasy, baby.

Browning Out rode Puka Nacua's 46.50 nuclear weapon to a 193-point laugher over Christian McCalfinjury. Mattwunder got 32.60 from his namesake CMC and STILL lost, partly because Romeo Doubs put up 19.40 from the bench like a punk.

T Swift's Baddies beat The Good Ladds 135-111, which sounds clean until you find out Tnicolle left 56.64 points on the bench. Alec Pierce (24.60) and Chig Okonkwo (19.40) watched from the sideline while Stafford carried the offense. Mig56 countered by benching Stefon Diggs for 22.80 — Jayden 1, Jayden 2, and Jayden 3 couldn't save him from his own roster management. Both of you are lucky the other one was equally stupid.

weeklyAwards.title: Scorched Earth Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: 227.80 in a playoff game is just disrespectful — Better than Bo lived up to the nickname and then some.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coach of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Won the game and STILL left 56.64 points rotting on the pine — Alec Pierce and Chig Okonkwo deserved better.

weeklyAwards.title: Please Stop Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: 73.98 points in Week 16 is the fantasy equivalent of forfeiting and going to bed at 9pm.

weeklyAwards.title: Heimlich Maneuver Recipient
weeklyAwards.blurb: Lost by 2.68 with Tyjae Spears and his 21.50 points napping on the bench — Kyle, that one's gonna haunt you all offseason.
